issues.title: s2: ReadFrom retains bytes.Buffer input after returning
gzhttp: buffered Write does not commit the implicit HTTP status
zstd: EncodeAll with a dictionary copies the whole 256 KiB fast table for most small inputs (fastEncoderDict.Reset)
S2 CLI tools: unsafe output file creation (symlink/TOCTOU, set-ID propagation, tar extraction)
zstd: EncodeAll with a dictionary costs ~6–10 µs per small message, mostly building entropy tables
Add support for parrallel decode on frame boundaries.

discussions.title: zstd: support magicless frames, and decoding frames without a dictionary ID
Invalid zip file in release package
Is there any chance to support decryption of encrypted files?
Feature Request / Optimization: FSE-only Literal Compression Fallback for Constrained Alphabet Data (e.g., Base64/DNA) on Fast Levels
Expose GZIP/DEFLATE decompressor state (sliding window & bit-offsets) to enable zran / ratarmount style index generation
Versioning question: new zstd support introduced in patch release (v1.18.4)

latest_release.name: v1.20.4
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* zstd: don't reuse a literal table that was not written by @klauspost in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1299
* zstd: preserve stream state when resetting options by @Grivn in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1266
* zstd, huff0, s2: bump the avo arm64 lowering; keep zstd stack slots in registers by @lizthegrey in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1248
* zstd, huff0: faster pure-Go decoders by @lizthegrey in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1256
* zstd: Don't retain pointers to decoded inputs in DecodeAll by @Jille in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1273
* zstd: inline the best encoder's reject path; cap concurrent-blocks job size by @bd-dstodolsky in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1293
* zstd: copy non-overlapping matches in 32-byte blocks by @lizthegrey in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1295
* zstd: cap DecodeAll preallocation to what the input can decode to by @Raghuvardhan-Reddy78 in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1291
* flate: build unrestricted Huffman trees before limiting lengths by @klauspost in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1219
* flate: Fix stateless EOF on large writes. by @klauspost in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1265
* flate: keep match history across small flushes by @klauspost in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1282
* gzip: write and read a zero MTIME for a zero ModTime by @spicysharkco in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1268
* zip: accept 0xFFFFFFFF sizes and offsets without a Zip64 extra by @ybai08 in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1267
* zip: backport the standard library's writer-side Zip64 fixes by @ybai08 in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1287
* gzip: backport two standard library fixes (truncated header EOF, Write count) by @ybai08 in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1270
* gzhttp: let "*" in Accept-Encoding select gzip or zstd by @Shaisolaris in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1263
* gzhttp: flush and hijack through http.ResponseController by @Neffi42 in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1272
* gzhttp: keep Vary: Accept-Encoding when the handler sets Vary by @wleeaf in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1284
* gzhttp: don't pool a decoder while a Read is still using it by @Raghuvardhan-Reddy78 in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1288
* gzhttp: clear Content-Length when decoding a compressed request by @Raghuvardhan-Reddy78 in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1301
* huff0: promote the 4X loop's input pointers to registers on arm64 by @lizthegrey in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1277
* s2: verify the CRC of chunk data kept after Skip by @Raghuvardhan-Reddy78 in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1286
* s2: don't read past src when converting LZ4 blocks by @Raghuvardhan-Reddy78 in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1294
* s2: fix LZ4 converter length overflow (32-bit only) by @klauspost in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1300
* s2: return ErrDstTooSmall for an LZ4 conversion into a nil dst by @yxshee in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1307
* s2: keep ErrCorrupt when Skip rejects an oversized chunk by @CJstate in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1303

## New Contributors
* @Shaisolaris made their first contribution in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1263
* @Grivn made their first contribution in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1266
* @spicysharkco made their first contribution in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1268
* @ybai08 made their first contribution in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1267
* @Neffi42 made their first contribution in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1272
* @wleeaf made their first contribution in https://github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1284
* @oddharsh made their first contribution in https://github.com/
